description:
Construction price index for residential buildings. Source: Bundesbank.

Quarterly data (2015=100).

Parameters:
- start/end: YYYY-MM-DD
- recent: number of most recent periods

Key response fields (German names):
- preisindex: Construction price index for residential buildings (2015=100)
- preisindex_delta_1q: Change vs. previous quarter (index points)
- preisindex_delta_1j: Change vs. previous year (index points)
